eyebrow: Coming soon for iPhone and iPad
h1: The MTG app that knows your cards
lead: Scan your collection, build decks from what you own and play with friends. Mote, your AI deck expert, does the math.
note: Free to download · iPhone and iPad · iOS 18 or later
hero_alt: A foil Giada, Font of Hope tilting in ManaPal's card viewer, catching the light

chapters.title: Point. Scan. Done.
chapters.text: Card after card without stopping, or a whole binder page in one photo: all nine cards land in your collection, each in its pocket, with its price.
chapters.alt: The camera scanner recognizes The One Ring and adds it with its price

chapters.title: Build decks that click.
chapters.text: See your deck in piles, sorted by cost. Tap a card to see how it works with the rest of the deck, the combos it's one card away from and what you could play instead.
chapters.alt: A Commander deck in two piles of cards; Juri opens with its synergies, a combo and alternatives

chapters.title: Your cards, like you've never seen them.
chapters.text: Open any card and tilt it: foils catch the light. Rules text, official rulings and prices from every store are one swipe away.
chapters.alt: Opening a card from the collection grid into its detail page

chapters.title: The Commander made for you.
chapters.text: Answer 12 questions about how you play. Mote picks three commanders, with budget, mid and top lists, and you can import decks that placed at real tournaments.
chapters.alt: Mote reveals three suggested commanders: Lathril, Atarka and Omnath

chapters.title: An expert that reads your cards.
chapters.text: Mote analyzes your deck and suggests swaps with cards you already own. One tap and they're in. It can also build a whole deck from your collection.
chapters.alt: Mote's deck analysis lists suggested swaps marked You own it, then applies five swaps

chapters.title: Test it before you sleeve it.
chapters.text: Draw an opening hand, mulligan, play your first turns. See the odds of drawing lands, your curve and what the missing cards cost.
chapters.alt: A playtest: opening hand, a mulligan and the first cards on the battlefield

chapters.title: Everything for the table.
chapters.text: A life counter for 2 to 6 players with commander damage, poison, monarch and initiative. Hold the die, let it roll, and every game reaches your friends' phones.
chapters.alt: Holding and rolling the 3D twenty-sided die over a four-player life counter

more_lead: Everything a Magic player needs, in one app.

more.title: Rules at the table
more.text: The Comprehensive Rules and every card's rulings, offline. Ask Mote for a verdict.

more.title: Play with friends
more.text: Add friends with a QR code: shared games and a playgroup leaderboard.

more.title: Every precon
more.text: Official preconstructed decks with their description, ready to import.

more.title: Tournament decks
more.text: Lists that placed at Commander tournaments, from TopDeck.gg.

more.title: Stats and combos
more.text: Curve, lands, colors, combos and the value of your deck.

more.title: Bring your cards
more.text: Import from ManaBox, Moxfield, Archidekt, Delver Lens and more.

more.title: Binders, wishlist, trade
more.text: Organize your cards and see which sets you're completing.

more.title: iCloud and 14 languages
more.text: Synced on iPhone and iPad, in your language and your currency.

free_items: A free quick AI question every day
pricing_note: AI actions use Mana and you always see the cost before an action starts.
